question: Which one of the following features is NOT shown by metals?

options.text: Can be made into a wire

solution:
The correct answer is **__Looks dull.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dullness refers to the lack of shine or brightness which is not a characteristic property of metals.**
 
• Metals do display:
 
 
• Malleability-ability to be drawn into thin sheets.
 
• Ductility-ability to be drawn into thin wires.
 
• Electrical Conductivity- ability to allow the electric current to pass through it.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
